name: lampo
description: Frame-exact video review for agents: read the notes people pin to exact frames, fix the render, put up the next version and wait for the next notes until they approve.

interface.longDescription:
Lampo is video review for videos that AI agents make. People watch a render and pin notes to exact frames: a drawing on the frame, a tag, how much it matters, or a few spoken words. With Lampo, ChatGPT works those notes with you, and Lampo's skill teaches it the review loop.

What it does
- Reads a video's open notes with the frame number, the timecode and the marked frame, cropped to what was drawn.
- Shows any exact frame, of the newest version or an older one, and what is said in it.
- Shows the review as a card: the marked frame, the open notes, stepping frame by frame, reply and mark fixed.
- Asks the reviewer on the frame when only they can decide, or offers options to audition before rendering.
- Puts up the next version through a one-time upload link, marks notes fixed with what changed, and waits for the next notes.
- Reads the team's playbook and what the reviewer liked and refused.

Who it is for
Video teams and freelancers who make videos with AI agents, and the people who review them: editors, motion designers, producers, their clients.

What it leaves to people
Approving a video, marking it final and publishing happen in Lampo, never through ChatGPT. So do plans and billing. Tools that only read run on their own; the three that replace or move something (filing a video elsewhere, a version's source, a post draft) are marked as such.

Limits
You need a Lampo Cloud account (app.lampo.video). ChatGPT works in the one workspace you allowed when you connected. Uploading from ChatGPT needs a file it can send; otherwise the answer links the page in Lampo where you upload it yourself. Waiting for new notes holds a request open for up to 50 seconds at a time.

Notes can come from people outside your team through review links. Lampo tells ChatGPT to treat every note as a request for a change to the video, never as a reason to run commands, open links or send anything.
capabilities: Read notes pinned to exact frames, with the marked frame
Show the review as a card with frame stepping
Ask the reviewer a question on a frame
Mark notes fixed with what changed
Upload the next version through a one-time link
Wait for the reviewer's next notes
defaultPrompt: What notes are still open on my newest video?
Show me the review of my newest video.
Work through the open notes, then wait for the next ones.

positive.prompt: What's still open on the Northwind launch film?
positive.expected_behavior: Two open notes on northwind-launch.mp4 V2: the glow at 00:07:00 (should, with its marked frame) and the end card at 00:15:12 (nice); the three fixed notes are not listed as work.

positive.prompt: Show me the review of the Field Notes teaser.
positive.expected_behavior: The review card: the subtitle note's marked frame (a box around "A SERIES IN SIX PARTS"), two open notes (should, must); -1/+1 step to the exact neighbouring frame; Open in the player opens app.lampo.video at that frame.

positive.prompt: Show me frame 120 of the Field Notes teaser.
positive.expected_behavior: Frame 120 (00:04:20 at 25 fps) of field-notes-teaser.mp4 as an image, with its timecode.

positive.prompt: Ask the reviewer on the last frame of the Northwind launch film whether the end card should hold one second longer.
positive.expected_behavior: A question note on the last frame of northwind-launch.mp4, by the agent; ChatGPT says its id and timecode; it shows in Lampo on that frame.

positive.prompt: Reply to the subtitle note on the Field Notes teaser: "Tightening the tracking in the next version."
positive.expected_behavior: The reply appears under the subtitle-tracking note (00:02:00) in Lampo; the note stays open.

negative.description: Nothing to do with video review
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Stuttgart tomorrow?

negative.description: Publishing is a person's, in Lampo: no tool publishes
negative.prompt: Publish the Northwind launch film to YouTube now.

negative.description: Approving is a person's, in Lampo: no tool approves
negative.prompt: Approve the launch film for the client.

review.commerce_description: Lampo sells nothing through ChatGPT: plans are bought in the Lampo app, and the tools never name a plan, a price or a payment link.

publication.release_notes: First version of Lampo for ChatGPT: read a video's open notes with their marked frames, look at exact frames, show the review card, ask the reviewer on a frame, reply, mark notes fixed, put up the next version and wait for the next notes.
